vegetation.tooltip.arm_bend_33386f: How strongly arms bend, in degrees.
vegetation.tooltip.arm_frequency_450014: How often arms grow from the column.
vegetation.tooltip.arm_length_m_c6f448: Length of each arm or segment.
vegetation.tooltip.arm_splay_bee9a5: How far arms spread out from the column, in degrees.
vegetation.tooltip.branch_angle_703efa: How far branches spread away from the trunk, in degrees.
vegetation.tooltip.branch_density_863e46: How many branches grow from the trunk and limbs. Higher values are bushier.
vegetation.tooltip.branch_levels_8d2d81: How many generations of branching the plant has. More levels add fine twigs and many more triangles; at the maximum some species lose their leaves.
vegetation.tooltip.branchiness_b3804e: How likely a stem is to fork.
vegetation.tooltip.column_growth_m_seg_c: How much taller the column grows with each segment.
vegetation.tooltip.column_segments_239e6: How many segments the column has. More segments are taller and heavier.
vegetation.tooltip.column_thickness_0e81: Scales the thickness of the column.
vegetation.tooltip.crown_shape_adef0b: The overall outline of the crown, such as conical, spherical or flame-shaped.
vegetation.tooltip.crown_spread_16fb5c: How wide the crown grows compared with its height.
vegetation.tooltip.describe_the_plant_17: Type what you want, such as “an old windswept pine with a thin crown”. A language model suggests a species, a seed and control values. You always see them as normal controls first; nothing is queued until you press Add to queue.
vegetation.tooltip.feeder_spacing_m_d40f: Distance between the small feeding branches.
vegetation.tooltip.fork_generations_1f8a: How many times the stems fork. More generations are denser and heavier.
vegetation.tooltip.fork_spread_05d298: How far forks spread apart, in degrees.
vegetation.tooltip.gnarliness_565a83: How twisted and bent the limbs are. Higher values look older and more weathered.
vegetation.tooltip.height_m_eb6014: Overall height of the plant in metres before randomness is applied.
vegetation.tooltip.leaf_angle_f30d94: How far leaves hang away from their twig, in degrees.
vegetation.tooltip.leaf_billboard_874707: Single uses one card per leaf; Crossed uses two crossing cards, which looks fuller from any side and uses more triangles.
vegetation.tooltip.leaf_size_558175: Scales every leaf or needle spray.
vegetation.tooltip.leaf_size_variance_34: How much leaf sizes differ from each other.
vegetation.tooltip.leaf_start_23a51b: How far along each twig the leaves begin, from the base (0) to the tip (1).
vegetation.tooltip.leaves_branch_d43415: How many leaves grow on each twig. More leaves add triangles.
vegetation.tooltip.primary_scaffolds_a43: Number of main limbs that leave the trunk.
vegetation.tooltip.rib_depth_d67209: How deep the grooves between ribs are.
vegetation.tooltip.ribs_737e46: Number of ribs around the column.
vegetation.tooltip.rosette_size_25a759: Size of the leaf rosettes at the tips.
vegetation.tooltip.seed_d07208: A whole number from 1 to 9999. The same species, seed and settings always give the same plant; another seed is another individual of the species.
vegetation.tooltip.show_leaves_8b5743: Turn off to export the bare branches only.
vegetation.tooltip.species_c6e1cc: The kind of plant SeedThree grows. Each species has its own shape controls. Changing species resets the controls you tuned.
vegetation.tooltip.spine_density_090a16: How many spines cover the plant. Fewer spines mean fewer triangles.
vegetation.tooltip.sprays_per_twig_f428e: Number of leaf sprays on each twig.
vegetation.tooltip.stem_splay_b85c3a: How far stems lean away from each other, in degrees.
vegetation.tooltip.stems_from_crown_166e: Number of stems that grow from the root crown.
vegetation.tooltip.triangle_budget_ad930: Which level of detail is exported. SeedThree builds three: the most detailed has the most triangles. The counts shown are measured for the default design of the species.
vegetation.tooltip.trunk_height_m_1432a8: Height of the bare trunk before it branches.
vegetation.tooltip.trunk_thickness_ee53a: Scales the thickness of the trunk and main limbs.
vegetation.tooltip.trunks_cfbc4d: How many main trunks the plant has.
vegetation.tooltip.trunks_rare_1_53bb76: How many trunks grow from the base; more than one is rare in nature.
vegetation.tooltip.variations_7be51e: Queue 1 to 4 plants at once. They use consecutive seeds starting from the seed above, and are shown as Variation 1 of N.
